_doc: Tax-loss harvesting substitute pairs. Each key is a ticker; value is a substitute with near-identical exposure but distinct legal identity. Used by --tlh pass to swap losing positions for substitutes without changing economic exposure. AU has no formal wash-sale rule but TR 2008/1 anti-avoidance applies: the substitute must be a genuinely different security. Pairs here are conservative — same/near-same index, different issuer or domicile.
